attack: A12 the endpoint: score without mathematics, and lose a genuine advance
caveat: The SCORING half is measured here exactly. Whether Lean accepts rotate_left / rename_i / clear at a given anchor is not re-measured (Lean is busy); it is standard Mathlib behaviour but is marked PLAUSIBLE end-to-end, CONFIRMED for the scoring rule.

E4_untrusted_axiom_closure.note: closed_all_goals comes straight from the REPL's `no goals` sentinel. RT-01's fix (the TRUSTED_AXIOMS allow-list) lives in verify_closed_script, which this assay never calls, so a native_decide closure would score an event with Lean.ofReduceBool in its trust base and nothing would record it.

E5_ok_step_with_no_reported_state.note: an OK step whose tactic_state the backend did not report scores 0, not a harness failure -- a genuine advance would be silently recorded as a no-op

E6_change_erased_by_normalisation.note: normalize_goal_text rstrips each line, so a change that is only trailing whitespace is invisible. Harmless for real tactics.

E7_parent_falls_back_to_the_bank.note: `live.parent_state_text(...) or anchor.solver_visible.goals_pp` -- if the session returns None or '' the comparison silently switches from the LIVE parent to the BANK's recorded text. The two agree only up to the re-elaboration key, which is a hash of the NORMALISED text, so a live/bank divergence inside the normalisation would not be caught.
